baseline: v49 accepted rotation; unchanged v47 probabilities and v49 out-of-fold profiles
selection: Same earlier-three phase+pair objective and regulation-minute/short-share gates; >1% improvement. Baseline retained if none pass. If one passes, validate on disjoint 120 games per older season before target-season evaluation.
hypotheses: Single-player greedy swaps can miss beneficial multi-player changes. Enumerate feasible five-player lineups respecting locks, roles, rest, protected shooter.
Final-quarter taper can leave measured pair deficits uncorrected; test removing taper.
Penalize entering a player with insufficient remaining budget for the usual minimum stint, using the existing minimumStint, not a named-player rule.
stage: Final exploratory factorial combination of already specified pair phase, short-budget penalty, per-entry cost, urgency; no additional scalar search. If no candidate passes, keep v49 and close candidate.
measurement: Learn the distribution of joint oncourt seconds across 24 phases from training folds only. Shrink toward uniform phase timing by one training game worth of mean pair overlap. Zero-overlap or unseen pairs use the old marginal-progress path. Existing v49 pair-total targets unchanged.
